 TOP 10: November 2026 Aeronautical Engineer Licensure Exam AELE Topnotchers
 Author: Admin Published: November 12, 2026 0 comments AELE TOPNOTCHERS — The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) Board of Aeronautical Engineers releases the November 2026 Aeronautical Engineering Licensure Exam (AELE) results, including the top 10 or the list of topnotchers, immediately after the computer-based licensure exams.
 The Aeronautical Engineering Licensure Examination was conducted on November 9–11, 2026, at designated PRC testing centers in NCR, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Legazpi, Lucena, Pampanga, and Rosales. The Board of Aeronautical Engineering is headed by Chairman Engr. Ernesto B. Ferreras Jr., with Engr. Redentor C. Malia as member, based on the latest confirmed PRC results announcement.

 List of Topnotchers
 PRC recognizes the top 10 examinees who garnered the highest examination ratings in its administered licensure exams. Below is the list of the top 10 examinees from the November 2026 Aeronautical Engineering board exams, along with their schools and ratings.
 ➔ Follow us on our Facebook and Twitter pages or join us at the Board Exam Results Broadcast Channel to receive updates through chat. 
 Release of Results
 According to PRC Resolution No. 2113, series of 2025, which provides the schedule of licensure examinations for 2026, the November 2026 Aeronautical Engineering Licensure Examination results are targeted for release on November 13, 2026.
 This is equivalent to two (2) working days after the last day of examinations on November 11, 2026.
 However, the actual release of results may occur earlier or later than the target date, depending on the PRC’s final processing and verification.
 During the December 2025 Aeronautical Engineers Computer-Based Licensure Examination, the results were released immediately after the last day of examinations.
 Meanwhile, the December 2024 AELE results were released after one (1) working day.
 Examinees are advised to bookmark this page and regularly check the PRC official website for announcements.
 Schedule of Registration
 The schedule for online appointments for the issuance of Professional Identification Cards (IDs) and Certificates of Registration for successful November 2026 Aeronautical Engineering Licensure Examination examinees will be announced by the PRC upon the release of results.
 Date(s) of Registration: Starting December 10, 2026 
 Successful examinees must register online through the official PRC website at https://online.prc.gov.ph/ .
 Based on previous PRC registration guidelines, applicants should prepare the following requirements:
 Notice of Admission (NOA), for identification purposes only
 Downloaded and duly accomplished Oath Form or Panunumpa ng Propesyonal
 Two (2) passport-sized colored photographs with a white background and complete name tag
 Two (2) sets of documentary stamps
 One (1) short brown envelope
 The PRC requires successful examinees to personally complete their initial registration and sign the Roster of Registered Professionals.
 Applicants should check the official PRC announcement for any changes to the registration requirements before their scheduled appointment.
 Verification of Rating
 The November 2026 Aeronautical Engineering Licensure Examination ratings will be available for online verification through the PRC after the official results are released.
 Examinees may access the PRC Verification of Rating page to check their examination ratings.
 The following information is generally required:
 Examination name
 Date of examination
 Application number
 First name
 Last name
 Date of birth
 Examinees should ensure that the information provided matches their official examination records.
 Oath-Taking Ceremonies
 The schedule and venue for the oath-taking ceremony of successful November 2026 Aeronautical Engineering Licensure Examination examinees will be announced by the PRC.
 Successful examinees interested in attending the face-to-face mass oath-taking must register through https://online.prc.gov.ph/ within the deadline prescribed by the PRC.
 Under previous PRC guidelines, registration for face-to-face mass oath-taking was required no later than 12:00 PM on the day before the scheduled ceremony.
 Those who cannot attend the mass oath-taking may opt for virtual oath-taking or request special oath-taking, subject to PRC availability and instructions.
 For virtual oath-taking, successful examinees may schedule an appointment through PRC Online Services and select the e-OATH transaction.
 The online registration period generally closes five (5) calendar days before the scheduled virtual oath-taking.
 Inductees are required to print their Oath of Professional form and comply with the instructions issued by the PRC.
 After completing the oath-taking requirements, successful examinees may proceed with initial registration through PRC Online Services.
